dmm-2021-tiebreaker-01.prompt: You are standing on one of the faces of a cube. Each turn, you randomly choose another face that shares an edge with the face you are standing on with equal probability, and move to that face. Let $F(n)$ be the probability that you land on the starting face after $n$ turns. Suppose that $F(8)=\frac{43}{256}$, and $F(10)$ can be expressed as a simplified fraction $\frac ab$. Find $a+b$.
